reviews.x: Works great for active toddler boy. He has thick hair and it holds almost all day. Doesn’t look greasy. Smell is fine, no sticky residue on your hands after applying. Ingredients seem all natural per stated. Residual washes right out in the bath.  I’m glad I reconsidered returning/got lazy. I considered returning when the product came because the tin jar it comes in was beat up from shipping. It wasn’t shipped by Amazon in protective packaging - just a bubble envelope. The label looks hand print

Made my poor babys scalp scaly and red and then it peeled off. He isn't allergic to any of the ingredients listed so I'm confused as to why he had a reaction. He is very clearly in pain. Not to mention when I used it (before the reaction) it didn't hold up good at all. It smells really nice though! Texture is kinda gross in your hands but it is gel so I kind of expected that. Overall very unhappy with this.

My daughter has some curly frizzy hair when she wakes up!…and this product works great for taming, styling and controlling her cute but frizzy hair! We absolutely love it! It washes out super easy and smells yummy too! I definitely have recommended this product to friends with kids that are looking for a good kid friendly hair product and will continue to recommend it!

I was looking for a natural product to use on my toddlers hair. Im so happy that Ive found this one! Smells amazing by the way, a mix that reminds me of fruits like watermelon or melon. Its natural and holds great! Exactly what I was looking for and with a great smell included in the package!

I’ve tried many kid safe gels and none of them last. This stuff is hands down the best product to tame toddler hair. It’s more like a pomade, even though it’s clear like gel. A little bit adds Some texture and hold, but doesn’t make the hair hard or anything. It also comes off your hands extremely easily. I have a crazy active little boy and this last quite a while in his hair. After naptime he usually needs a little dab more, but that’s to be expected.

Have a little girl whose hair has always been hard to maintain and tame, but I use a little of this product and her hair, African American hair, literally stays laid down all day. I’ve never had an issue with this product and it’s clean ingredients!!! Thank you so much!!! So many children’s hair gels doesn’t keep my child’s hair laid, but this does!!! A little goes a long way.

reviews.t: Good but doesn’t hold for long
reviews.x: It does have a strong watermelon scent but that didn’t bother my child. My son has straight hair so this product held it for a couple of hours then his hair would fall back in his face. I love that it’s a cleaner product and easy to wash out of his hair but I need more hold for his hair type.

reviews.t: It works great for my family
reviews.x: Day two with this product and I LOVE it. It holds my sons hair without making white after a days use.  It is amazing for my sons hair. My husband now uses it too because he sees how my sons hair looks.
Has a nice hold, a little goes a long way but not an all day hold. Pleasant light scent. I've used it on my 1yr old son and my 4yr old daughter. On the pricer side but I'd recommend.
I paid $18 for this dirty and disgusting package. It made me wonder if it was used and sent back and pass it to next new customer. Wasn’t impressed at all.

My son has a lot of hair. In this picture, he has a haircut, which his hair doesn’t really stay in place, even when I use hair conditioner at bath time. The product smells so good and a little goes a long way! You can also comb the hair in place after applying the product, and hair does not dry into a rock. It stays moist and luscious.  I also love the fact that it’s plant based and as a mom, I’m very careful with unnecessary chemicals being in my child’s hair or on his body.

We have tried a few gels and pomades on our toddler’s hair to help tame bed head or to add a few spikes for fun or other stylings. This stuff smells amazing and my husband even steals it sometimes. It is very light and easy to manipulate, yet holds well throughout the day. A little goes a long way, so we definitely think it is worth the price point. This is hands down our favorite.

Love this product! My son is just over one and finally got his first haircut so I was looking for a product to style his hair in a faux hawk or messy spike hairstyle. This is the 5th product I’ve tried and I really like it. It takes a little bit to dry but once it does it holds and doesn’t look “wet” and isn’t crunchy. It even made it through nap time. Finally a product I’ll keep!

Love this product!! smells good and doesn’t leave a sticky after weird touch. My baby hair holds great and does not flake or turns white even if you don’t get to wash it, the next day looks normal it does come off but looks and feels good. Bought it twice already
I really like this. I have 4c hair and the hold is great. I especially like that there are no sulfates and parabens.  The Yuka app gives this product 100/100!!  Excellent.
Love this stuff. Little goes a long way smells like watermelon! Love it!

I really love using this product. At the beginning it was a little hard to use it as my baby has just a little but crazy hair and when applied it he looked like his head was licked by a cow 🤣 I use it with wet hands so I make sure I am applying the right amount of product. It gets dissolve pretty easy with water, even if you apply too much product you van easily fix it with a wet towel or baby swipe. Smells amazing

This this smells great and it’s really like a pomade like the ones men use so it’s super cute that it’s for kids however I suggest the use for toddlers and up because I used it on my 4 month old and he didn’t let me style it to the point where he moved around and the hair felt sticky and stiff it’s nice and will save for him for when he’s a year or so but not recommend for baby hair

reviews.t: Highly recommend, even for pre-teens hair.
reviews.x: The scent is strong upon application, as nice as it is, it does take some getting used to. Also, my child is a tad sensitive to odors, so I just use as little as possible to get his curly hair away from his face. But overall, I prefer this product than a chemical option.  I highly recommend.

This stuff is great. Smells like melons and works awesome for my 2 year olds mini mohawk. By the end of the day it is mostly gone and doesn't leave the hair feeling gross at all! Almost like there was nothing there.

All the ingredients look great which is why I chose it. Unfortunately it left sores on my sons forehead.  We took a break from using it before trying again and the same thing happened. Had to toss it. Very bizarre.
Love that this product has more hold than others I’ve tried, isn’t sticky after it dries, isn’t too shiny and lasts all day even through a nap! 10/10, will definitely buy again!
This is amazing for children’s hair. It is also amazing for eye brows. The tiniest bit in the brows and then brush them through, and you’re set!
I wish I knew about this earlier! The scent doesn't smell artificial-- it's clean. I love that it holds and doesn't build up.

claims.text: Most reviewers say it holds hair well, especially for thick or curly hair, though a few note the hold doesn't last all day for some hair types.
Many reviewers praise the pleasant scent, often describing it as a light watermelon or fruity smell.
Reviewers frequently highlight the clean, natural ingredients and that it washes out easily without leaving residue or white flakes.
Several reviewers note that a little goes a long way and it doesn't leave hair hard or sticky.
A few negative reviews mention scalp irritation or peeling, poor hold, and a dirty or damaged package.
